title.zh: Payward Closes Bitnomial Acquisition, Gains Full US Derivatives Licenses
title.en: Payward Closes Bitnomial Acquisition, Gains Full US Derivatives Licenses

current_state.zh: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, completed its acquisition of Bitnomial, giving it a full set of US derivatives licenses covering exchange, clearing, and brokerage functions.
